details: Bitcoin's price moved towards $80,000 following the release of US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, which also pushed bond yields to new 22-year highs. This suggests a complex interplay between traditional financial indicators and the crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Nears $80K as US CPI Data and Bond Yields Drive Market

details: Ethereum experienced a 10% surge in just two hours, pushing its price past $2,600. This upward movement was largely attributed to a significant 14% jump in large whale transactions, indicating increased institutional or large-holder activity.
title: Ethereum Surges 10% Amidst Whale Transaction Spike

details: The proposed CLARITY Act, aimed at clarifying cryptocurrency regulations in the US, is facing a critical 60-vote cloture test in the Senate. This legislative hurdle comes as discussions continue around stablecoins, tokenization, and derivatives, highlighting ongoing regulatory challenges.
title: CLARITY Act Faces 60-Vote Senate Hurdle as Crypto Regulation Evolves

details: Filecoin (FIL) saw a significant 25% price increase, reaching $1. This rally was fueled by new messaging regarding supply reduction, recent governance changes, and leveraged trading activities, contributing to a volatile but bullish 9-hour period.
title: Filecoin Jumps 25% on Supply Reduction News and Bullish Narrative

details: XRP experienced a 3.8% price rise in five hours, driven by investor speculation surrounding the US CLARITY Act. Traders are betting that the act could officially codify XRP as a digital commodity, with derivatives positioning and ETF inflows further amplifying the positive price movement.
title: XRP Gains 3.8% on Speculation Over US CLARITY Act Vote

details: Zcash (ZEC) climbed 3.18% in five hours, propelled by its integration with THORChain, a new listing on SwissBorg, and increased whale activity. These developments are part of a broader uptrend supported by new liquidity venues and a positive market narrative for the asset.
title: Zcash Rises 3.18% Following THORChain Integration and SwissBorg Listing
